text: The most common Hawaii licence plate is **white** with an **arcing rainbow** across the centre of the plate. When blurred, you can sometimes see the outline of the rainbow. Front plates are required in Hawaii.
text_zh: 最常見的夏威夷車牌是**白色**的，車牌正中央有一道**成弧形的彩虹**。當影像模糊時，有時可以看到彩虹的輪廓。夏威夷規定必須懸掛前車牌。

text: Hawaii is the only state to use its own language, though English is still predominantly used. Most **place names** are in Hawaiian, so you can spot it on street signs, and other road markers.
- Hawaiian is a vowel-oriented language that only uses eight consonants: H, K, L, M, N, P, W, and (ʻ), called an [ʻOkina](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/%CA%BBOkina).
- Every Hawaiian word ends in one of 5 vowels: A, E, I, O, or U.
- Each vowel can also have a [macron](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Macron_(diacritic)) over it: Ā, Ē, Ī, Ō, and Ū.
These vowels are often combined to make [Diphthongs](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Diphthong). I.e. UI, AI, AE, etc...
text_zh: 夏威夷是唯一使用自身語言的州，不過英語仍然佔壓倒性多數的使用率。大多數**地名**都是夏威夷語，因此你可以在路標和其他道路標誌上發現它。
- 夏威夷語是一種以母音為主的語言，只使用八個子音：H、K、L、M、N、P、W 和 (ʻ)，稱為 [ʻOkina](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/%CA%BBOkina)。
- 每個夏威夷單字都以 A、E、I、O 或 U 這 5 個母音之一結尾。
- 每個母音上方也可以加上[長音符](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Macron_(diacritic))：Ā、Ē、Ī、Ō 和 Ū。
這些母音經常組合在一起形成[雙母音](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Diphthong)。例如 UI、AI、AE 等...

text: Hawaii has a large amount of Generation 4 **"smallcam"** coverage, which is mounted lower than regular Generation 4 and has a relatively big circular blur with a small protrusion at the front, with parts of the car being visible. The blur can also be fully transparent, making it harder to spot.
text_zh: 夏威夷有大量第四代**「小相機 (smallcam)」**街景覆蓋，其安裝位置比一般第四代相機低，且具有相對大的圓形模糊區域以及前方的一個小突起，車輛的一部分會露出來。模糊效果也可能是完全透明的，這使得它更難被發現。

text: Hawaii is known for its **lush** and **tropical** vegetation, with a variety of plants and trees. However, being a volcanic island chain, Hawaii has a wide range of landscapes, and as such vegetation as well.
You will often see plenty of [ferns](https://goo.gl/maps/Ki93sohMTCDs1MZM8), [tall grass](https://goo.gl/maps/vfprezHVC8j4r6wY9), or other flowers on the sides of the roads.
text_zh: 夏威夷以其**蒼翠**且**熱帶**的植被而聞名，擁有各種植物和樹木。然而，作為一個火山島鏈，夏威夷擁有廣泛的地貌，因此植被也很多樣。
你經常會在路邊看到大量的[蕨類植物](https://goo.gl/maps/Ki93sohMTCDs1MZM8)、[高草](https://goo.gl/maps/vfprezHVC8j4r6wY9)或其他花卉。

text: Topography on Hawaii is characterised by many **sloping volcanoes**, rugged **cliffs**, **hills**, **valleys** and **craters**. Such distinct topography combined with tropical vegetation is a good way to identify Hawaii.
text_zh: 夏威夷的地形特徵是許多**傾斜的火山**、崎嶇的**懸崖**、**山丘**、**山谷**和**火山口**。這種獨特的地形結合熱帶植被，是辨識夏威夷的好方法。

text: Contemporary Hawaiian homes are typically 1 or 2 storey wooden structures, commonly lighter in colour. Many homes feature **retaining walls made of volcanic rock.**
text_zh: 當代夏威夷住宅通常是 1 或 2 層樓的木造結構，顏色通常較淺。許多房屋都採用**火山岩砌成的擋土牆。**

text: Thick **yellow** bands can sometimes be seen on poles in Hawaii.
NOTE: Make sure not to confuse this with the 3 stripes found on Californian poles.
text_zh: 夏威夷的電線桿上有時可以看到厚重的**黃色**帶子。
注意：確保不要將此與加州電線桿上發現的 3 條條紋混淆。

text: Hawaii uses highway shields that resemble a **guitar pick**, with the numbers on the bottom of the shield. Most highway signs also use [yellow signposts](https://www.google.com/maps/@20.0269917,-155.6992435,3a,23y,129.32h,81.85t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s6nWi-67_zbEbhaLQER2TOg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205409&entry=ttu).
text_zh: 夏威夷使用酷似**吉他彈片**的高速公路盾牌標誌，數字位於盾牌底部。大多數公路標誌也使用[黃色路標柱](https://www.google.com/maps/@20.0269917,-155.6992435,3a,23y,129.32h,81.85t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1s6nWi-67_zbEbhaLQER2TOg!2e0!7i16384!8i8192?coh=205409&entry=ttu)。

text: A **stubby antenna** can be seen in most Generation 3 coverage on Hawaii.
NOTE: The antenna is not always visible, so make sure to look out for other clues before guessing.
text_zh: 在夏威夷的大多數第三代街景覆蓋中都可以看到一個**粗短的天線**。
注意：天線並不總是可見的，所以在猜測之前一定要尋找其他線索。

text: Hawaii has a fair amount of **Generation 2 coverage**, compared to other US states. Especially on more rural roads.
NOTE: Generation 2 can be recognized by the lower quality camera, and circular blur above and below the camera.
text_zh: 與其他美國各州相比，夏威夷擁有相當數量的**第二代街景覆蓋**。特別是在較鄉村的道路上。
注意：第二代街景可以透過較低相機畫質，以及相機上方和下方的圓形模糊來識別。

text: **Raised pavement markers** in Hawaii will commonly be placed in a specific pattern: a single reflector, followed by four reflectors put close together and then a single reflector, repeating the pattern.
text_zh: 夏威夷的**突起路標**通常會以特定的模式放置：一個單一反光器，接著是四個靠得很近的反光器，然後再一個單一反光器，並重複此模式。

text: **State highways** are grouped by their first digit, with 1 and 2 found on Hawaiʻi, 3 on Maui, 4 on Molokaʻi and Lānaʻi, 5 on Kauaʻi and 6 to 9 on Oʻahu.
Moreover, all four of the so-called [**interstate**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/fn5BwsZrBwz2DZeq5) highways are located on Oʻahu.
text_zh: **州級公路**按其第一位數字分組，1 和 2 位於夏威夷島，3 位於茂宜島，4 位於摩洛凱島和拉娜伊島，5 位於可愛島，6 到 9 位於歐胡島。
此外，所有四條所謂的[**州際公路**](https://maps.app.goo.gl/fn5BwsZrBwz2DZeq5)都位於歐胡島。

text: On the three largest islands, namely Hawaiʻi, Maui and Oʻahu, smallcam coverage was taken with a **black Google car**.
text_zh: 在三個最大的島嶼上，即夏威夷島、茂宜島和歐胡島，小相機街景是由一台**黑色 Google 車**拍攝的。

text: Smallcam imagery on the islands of Kauaʻi, Molokaʻi and Lānaʻi was captured by a **white car**. Just like with the black car, you will often be able to see the unblurred hood and mirrors.
text_zh: 可愛島、摩洛凱島和拉娜伊島上的小相機影像是由一台**白色車輛**拍攝的。就像黑色車一樣，你通常可以看到未模糊的引擎蓋和後照鏡。

text: **Generation 2** and **non-smallcam Generation 4** coverage can only be found on the islands of Hawaiʻi, Maui and Oʻahu. The other islands only have Generation 3 or smallcam coverage.
text_zh: **第二代**和**非小相機第四代**街景覆蓋只能在夏威夷島、茂宜島和歐胡島上找到。其他島嶼只有第三代或小相機街景覆蓋。

text: The Island of Kauaʻi is the furthest west island in Hawaii with official Google coverage. This island has deep red soil and has large **rugged hills** with lush, jungle-like vegetation.
NOTE: Other islands such as Maui and Molokaʻi have similar soil colours, but the hillsides on them will typically have [less dense vegetation](https://maps.app.goo.gl/D3FK2TyPBcA4LpPZ7).
text_zh: 可愛島是夏威夷擁有官方 Google 街景的最西邊島嶼。這個島嶼擁有深紅色的土壤，並有著大型**崎嶇山丘**以及蒼翠的叢林般植被。
注意：其他島嶼（如茂宜島和摩洛凱島）也有相似的土壤顏色，但那裡的山坡通常[植被較不濃密](https://maps.app.goo.gl/D3FK2TyPBcA4LpPZ7)。

text: The Island of Oʻahu** **lies southeast of Kauaʻi. It is known for being home to the Honolulu urban area. It also is home to **steep, lush hills**, which can be commonly seen from all around the island, especially in Honolulu’s suburbs.
text_zh: 歐胡島** **位於可愛島的東南方。它以作為檀香山都會區所在地而聞名。它也是**陡峭且蒼翠的山丘**的所在地，在整個島嶼周遭都很常見，特別是在檀香山的郊區。

text: Honolulu, located on southern Oʻahu, is by far the **largest city** and urban area in Hawaii. If you are in a dense urban area and can see tall buildings, you will always be in or near Honolulu.
text_zh: 位於歐胡島南部的檀香山，是夏威夷迄今為止**最大城市**和都會區。如果你身處密集的都會區並能看到高樓大廈，你一定身處檀香山或其附近。

text: The Island of Molokaʻi is just southeast of Oʻahu. It features **deep red soil** and a prominent [volcano](https://maps.app.goo.gl/q2AwtJcBg9UjyECS8) on the eastern end of the island. Especially in the older Generation 3 coverage, the vegetation appears very dry. Molokaʻi is also very sparsely populated.
text_zh: 摩洛凱島就位於歐胡島的東南方。它擁有**深紅色土壤**，且島嶼東端有一座顯著的[火山](https://maps.app.goo.gl/q2AwtJcBg9UjyECS8)。特別是在較舊的第三代街景中，植被顯得非常乾燥。摩洛凱島的人口也非常稀少。

text: The Island of Lānaʻi is a small, yet distinct island that lies just south of Moloka’i. A volcano is found just east of the centre of the island, adjacent to the town of Lānaʻi. In this area, tall [**Cook pines**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Araucaria_columnaris) are abundant. In addition, some main roads near the centre of the island are lined with younger Cook pines.
text_zh: 拉娜伊島是一個小而獨特的島嶼，位於摩洛凱島的正南方。火山位於島嶼中心正東方、鄰近拉娜伊鎮的地方。在這一帶，高大的[**庫克松**](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Araucaria_columnaris)比比皆是。此外，島嶼中心附近的一些主要道路兩旁也種滿了較年輕的庫克松。

text: Towards the coasts of the island of Lānaʻi, hills dotted with **dry grass and shrubby vegetation** are commonly seen. These areas are very rural with few buildings.
text_zh: 朝著拉娜伊島的海岸前進，經常可以看到點綴著**乾草與灌木植被**的山丘。這些地區非常鄉村化，建築物很少。

text: The Island of Maui sits southeast of Molokaʻi. In the centre of the island, you will find dry and somewhat flat grasslands with one or **both** of the **mountain ranges** on the island visible.
text_zh: 茂宜島位於摩洛凱島的東南方。在島嶼中心，你會發現乾燥且有些平坦的草原，島上的一座或**兩座**山脈清晰可見。

text: Coastal areas of Maui are noticeably more** lush and green**. Banana plants, palm trees, and [views of the mountains](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dm1N9dDprdoeUqWP7) are all common.
text_zh: 茂宜島的沿海地區明顯**更加蒼翠茂盛**。香蕉樹、棕櫚樹以及[山景](https://maps.app.goo.gl/dm1N9dDprdoeUqWP7)都很常見。

text: The Island of Hawai’i (also referred to as The Big Island) is both the largest and farthest southeast island with Street View coverage in the state. The interior areas feature **rolling, grassy plains **and** volcanic rocks**. You can typically see one or more of the island’s volcanoes from the road.
text_zh: 夏威夷島（也稱為大島）是該州擁有街景覆蓋的島嶼中，面積最大且最東南方的島嶼。內部地區特色為**起伏的草地平原**和**火山岩**。你通常可以從路上看到島上的一座或多座火山。

text: The coastal areas of the island of Hawai’i are where most of the towns and **built-up areas** on the island are located. These areas are typically more lush and have more trees and [fern plants](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3CBjiYMSAUukBp4n6) than the interior.
text_zh: 夏威夷島的沿海地區是島上大多數城鎮和**人口密集區**所在的地方。與內陸相比，這些地區通常更為蒼翠，擁有更多樹木和[蕨類植物](https://maps.app.goo.gl/3CBjiYMSAUukBp4n6)。

text: **Rural roads** going through forests within a flat landscape are commonly found south of the city of Hilo, on the island of Hawaiʻi.
NOTE: Mountainous forests are dotted around Hawaii, but if you are in one, and you see red soil with Generation 3, consider guessing in Kauaʻi, the westernmost covered island.
text_zh: 夏威夷島（Hawaiʻi）希洛（Hilo）市南方常見穿越平坦地景森林的**鄉間道路**。
注意：夏威夷各地散布著山地森林，但如果你身處其中，且看到搭配第三代相機的紅土，可以考慮猜在最西邊有街景涵蓋的考艾島（Kauaʻi）。

text: Within Hawaii, a distinct **green blur **can only be seen on the island of Oʻahu.
text_zh: 在夏威夷境內，只有歐胡島（Oʻahu）才看得到明顯的**綠色模糊**。

text: The infamous “**Hawaiian** **lattice**” can be recognized by the volcanic soil and rocks that are abundant in the region. Volcanic vegetation can also be seen lining the roads. Note that the angle of the roads is a big clue for the area, and that this lattice was built on the slope of Mauna Loa.
text_zh: 惡名昭彰的「**夏威夷** **棋盤格**」可以透過該地區豐富的火山土壤和岩石來辨識。道路兩旁也可以看到火山植被。請注意，道路的角度是該地區的重要線索，而且這個棋盤格是建造在冒納羅亞火山（Mauna Loa）的坡地上。

text: The town of **Kaunakakai** is the largest settlement on the Island of Molokaʻi. It is the only area on the island with an ‘urban’ vibe. As it is on Molokaʻi, the soil is somewhat [red](https://www.google.com/maps/@21.0916921,-157.0228608,3a,35.1y,334.14h,80.47t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sDIS1d-bt74niDWh5Nmv52w!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?coh=205409&entry=ttu).
text_zh: 考納卡凱（Kaunakakai）鎮是摩洛凱島（Molokaʻi）上最大的聚落。它是島上唯一帶有「都會」氛圍的地區。由於它位於摩洛凱島，土壤帶有少許[紅色](https://www.google.com/maps/@21.0916921,-157.0228608,3a,35.1y,334.14h,80.47t/data=!3m6!1e1!3m4!1sDIS1d-bt74niDWh5Nmv52w!2e0!7i13312!8i6656?coh=205409&entry=ttu)。

text: The **Red Hill** can easily be recognised by this unique barren, red rocky landscape. Due to the high altitude, clouds are usually visible below you.
text_zh: **紅山（Red Hill）**可以透過這種獨特荒涼、紅色岩石林立的地景輕鬆辨認。由於海拔較高，通常可以看到雲層在你的下方。

text: On the eastern side of the island of Molokaʻi lies the [Kamakou volcano](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kamakou), leading to a significantly hillier and slightly more vegetated landscape than the western parts of the island.
text_zh: 摩洛凱島的東側坐落著[卡馬庫火山](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Kamakou)，這使得當地的地形比該島西部明顯更加多山，植被也稍微多一些。

text: Kahoʻolawe is a small island that lies just to the southwest of Maui. It only has **trekker** coverage on small gravel roads and dirt trails, and is characterised by dry, shrubby vegetation, rolling hills, and **dark red soil**. On the western end of this coverage, [several buildings](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YWKLmJiGrmEtBHTk9) can be seen.
text_zh: 卡胡奧拉韋島（Kahoʻolawe）是位於茂宜島（Maui）西南方的一座小島。它的小碎石路和泥土小徑只有**徒步拍攝**涵蓋，並以乾燥、灌木叢生的植被、起伏的山丘和**深紅色土壤**為特徵。在這個涵蓋範圍的西端，可以看到[數棟建築物](https://maps.app.goo.gl/YWKLmJiGrmEtBHTk9)。
